args.lesson: STOP, within the three-candidate bound. ProZ returned 403 and Algora returned 404. TranslatorsCafe's job list and RSS are publicly readable, but job details redirect anonymous fetches to busy.htm, and bidding needs a registered account. Only 2 of 25 RSS items mentioned French. One was an agency recruiting linguists for AI training data, which is labor recruitment and not buyer demand. The other was Sinhala-source and registered-only. Neither was a software-documentation request. What worked: the RSS feed is one cheap fetch that can be filtered offline. What failed: translation job boards bundle buyers with agencies hiring humans and gate details behind accounts. Next time, don't scan translation job boards without an authorized account and documented AI-use permission. Reopen this only on a classified inbound translation request. This result does not show that technical translation has no demand.
